channel.title: Paintbox Collection (Universal)
channel.description: Quantel Paintbox Collection — AI Nostalgia Edition — Universal (macOS 15+, Apple silicon and Intel)

item.title: Paintbox Collection (Universal) 2026.10.7
item.description:
• The palette's mixing area works again (V-Series, DPB, Harry, HAL, Henry): a stroke paints the brush colour from where the pen went down, so colours can be laid in and mixed; a still tap picks the colour under the pen and paints nothing. (Since 2 Oct the press picked the colour under the pen and the stroke painted with it, so nothing new could be mixed.)
  • Pots: a quick tap picks the pot's colour; hold for 0.6 s to drop the brush colour in.

item.title: Paintbox Collection (Universal) 2026.10.6.3
item.description:
• Digital Fine Art: with the palette up, a press anywhere on the picture now grabs the colour under the pen at once (it was a tap on the pen-up, which a deliberate pen press never satisfied — mouse picked, pen did not). Pots, the columns and the mixing area keep their tap grammar.
  • Otherwise as the previous release.

item.title: Paintbox Collection (Universal) 2026.10.6.2
item.description:
• "Check for Updates…" is now in the Paintbox Collection menu of the loading screen, under About (it was missing in every build so far). Updates are checked from the loading screen, not from inside a machine.
  • From 2026.10.6.1: the loading screen's machines open on macOS 15 Sequoia and later (they wrongly asked for macOS 26).
  • The Universal edition: six machines, the Metal display, Apple silicon and Intel, on this edition's own update feed.

item.title: Paintbox Collection (Universal) 2026.10.6.1
item.description:
• Fixes the loading screen on macOS 15: every machine read "needs macOS 26 or later" and could not be chosen. The Universal edition's machines now open on macOS 15 Sequoia and later, Apple silicon or Intel.
  • READ-ME corrected for the Universal edition.
  • Otherwise the same as universal-2026.10.6: the six machines, the Metal display, pixel-identical to the Apple-silicon release on Apple silicon. Updates stay on this edition's own feed.

item.title: Paintbox Collection (Universal) 2026.10.6
item.description:
• UNIVERSAL edition of the Quantel Paintbox Collection: the same six machines (Digital Fine Art, Digital Paint Box, Paintbox V-Series, Harry, HAL, Henry) and the same Metal display, built for macOS 15 Sequoia or later on both Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
  • Pixel-identical to the Apple-silicon release on Apple silicon. On Intel Macs the paint maths runs natively (no Rosetta); a discrete-GPU Mac uses managed Metal memory for the canvas.
  • This edition updates on its own feed — it will not offer you the macOS 26 release, and that release will not offer you this one. Updates arrive through Paintbox Collection › Check for Updates…
